tasks.label: Switchboard: hub
tasks.detail: Hub: tunnel on 127.0.0.1:8097, console + /mcp on http://127.0.0.1:8099 (settings from the repo's .env)

tasks.label: Switchboard: client
tasks.detail: Client: tunnels servers from ./mcp.json to the local hub (token from .env)

tasks.label: Console: dev server
tasks.detail: Vite on :5173 with hot reload, proxying /api and /mcp to a hub on :8099. Run the hub task too.

tasks.label: Console: build
tasks.detail: Rebuild hub/web/dist, which the hub binary embeds. Commit the result - CI fails if it is stale.

tasks.label: Test: hub (go)
tasks.detail: Go unit tests with the race detector (needs a C compiler; the dev shell has one).

tasks.label: Test: console (vitest)
tasks.detail: Component and hook tests for the console.

tasks.label: Test: console end-to-end (playwright)
tasks.command: go build -o "$TMPDIR/mcp-switchboard-hub" ./cmd/mcp-switchboard-hub && cd web && MCP_SWITCHBOARD_HUB_BINARY="$TMPDIR/mcp-switchboard-hub" npm run test:e2e
tasks.detail: Drives the built binary with a real client behind it. Needs browsers: npx playwright install chromium.

tasks.label: Test: python (client, harness, end-to-end)
tasks.command: go build -o "$TMPDIR/mcp-switchboard-hub" ./cmd/mcp-switchboard-hub && cd .. && MCP_SWITCHBOARD_HUB_BINARY="$TMPDIR/mcp-switchboard-hub" uv run pytest client/tests servers/harness/tests tests -q
tasks.detail: The acceptance suite runs a real client against the compiled hub, so it builds the binary first.

tasks.label: Build: container image
tasks.detail: Builds the shipped image. Uses the committed hub/web/dist, so build the console first if you changed it.

tasks.label: Build: nix package
tasks.detail: Builds the hub the way the NixOS module consumes it. Nix only sees git-tracked files, so `git add` new ones first.
